questions.stem_text: Virtually all of the crops important in the European Neolithic:

options.A: were primarily animal products, not plant-based.
options.C: were domesticated before groups became sedentary.
options.D: were domesticated at the same time at communal farms.
options.E: were mainly wild crops that were not domesticated until the Bronze Age.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - were imported from other regions.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is the Pleistocene ice mass in North America centered in the Rocky
Mountains?
Where did the world's first civilization develop?
Australian and America megafauna were probably wiped out by:

options.A: natural disasters such as volcanic eruptions or earthquakes.
options.C: the spread of invasive plant species which altered their habitat.
options.D: a sudden drastic climate change due to global warming.
options.E: humans who carried diseases over the land bridge.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - both humans and environmental changes.
